cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've assigned you the restaurant call. Cancel my anniversary table; the number's on the fridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Questions are deferred. You may take this one task off me before we discuss anything else.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. What if they offer another date?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may refuse it for me. Then sit here while I put the glasses away. I authorize a full account of your day; I don't have words for mine.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 assigns cancellation, A3 defers explanation and A5 permits refusal of a new date while directing company and harmless conversation, using superior terms to receive emotional support without naming the burden.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 cause question produces A3 task-first condition; B4 rescheduling question produces A5 delegated no and continued presence during putting glasses away.

relationship.evidence: B2 is concerned and B4 agrees while anticipating a practical question, so the helper supplies useful support rather than only sympathy.

heightening.evidence: B4 possible new date causes A5 to have B carry that refusal too, then stay through another emotionally loaded task.

specificity.evidence: A1 anniversary restaurant and A5 glasses establish a canceled occasion; the helper relation and precipitating event need not be specified.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 authorizing B day because A lacks words gives restrained status vulnerability, though the permission phrasing is formal.
